chapter: Cab Calloway, Harlem and New York musicians
title: Danny's eight years in Cab Calloway's band
summary: Smitty and Milt praise Danny's memory, and Danny says he was in Cab Calloway's band from 1939 to 1947, a great band overshadowed by its star.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Playing in Lionel Hampton's big band

blocks.x: He can think about the past.

Well, he's so...not so narrative, but he knows it all. And I'm just glad to have been in Cab Calloway's band for five or six years with him, and I saw this happen. He's telling me, "I saw him write these," "I saw him sit
You were with him for five years in the band, huh?
Yeah, I'm sure. Danny, how long were you in Cab's band?
So the band was real popular then.

'39 to '47. Oh, it was a great band. Really a great band. The band was greater than we ever got credit for, because Cab was a superstar, and people more or less came to hear Cab. But the musicians were conscientious enough to want to take care of it themselves, you know, to be good musicians and make the arrangements and everything.
Cab is still around, too, isn't he.
Yes, he's in very good shape. [THEN OFFERS SOME MORE REFRESHMENTS]...
